dataManagement.title: Data Management
dataManagement.exportInfo: Exports all decks, cards, tags, study history, and settings as a JSON file. Use it to migrate to another device or to restore data if it is lost.
dataManagement.importInfo: Restores from a backup JSON file. Choose between "Merge" and "Replace All." "Replace All" deletes all current data, so use with caution.
dataManagement.importReplaceConfirmMessage:
All current decks, cards, tags, and study history will be deleted and replaced with the imported data. 
This cannot be undone.
dataManagement.exportImageMessage: Including images increases the file size.
dataManagement.exportLargeSizeMessage:
Approx. {{size}} MB.
Files over 100 MB may affect export and import performance.
Continue?
dataManagement.exportTsvInfo: Exports cards of the selected deck as a TSV (tab-separated) file. You can open and edit it in spreadsheet apps like Numbers. Study history and code/image blocks are not included (converted to plain text).
dataManagement.importTsvInfo: Adds or updates cards from a TSV file. Files created or edited in Numbers also work. Keep the id column to overwrite existing cards; remove it and rows are added as new cards.
dataManagement.tsvExportNoteMessage:
Please note the following:

■ Study history is not included
■ Code and image blocks are converted to plain text (they cannot be restored on re-import)
dataManagement.tsvImportNoteMessage:
To update existing cards, keep the id column.
Removing or changing the id will create new cards instead.

sync.title: iCloud Sync
sync.lockedSubtitle: Upgrade to Pro to sync data across devices
sync.description: Sync data across devices signed in to the same Apple ID
sync.descriptionDetail: On app launch or when you tap "Sync Now," data is downloaded from iCloud. When you close the app, your edits are uploaded to iCloud. Data is stored in iCloud Drive and not shared with anyone outside of Apple.
sync.iCloudUnavailable: iCloud is unavailable. Enable iCloud Drive in Settings.
sync.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
sync.offlinePending: You're offline. Your changes will sync to iCloud once you reconnect.
sync.schemaVersionMismatch: Data was synced by a newer version of the app. Please update.
sync.syncTimeout: Sync timed out. Check your connection and try again in a moment
sync.storageFull: Not enough iCloud storage. Free up some space and try again
sync.forceUploadInfo: Overwrites iCloud data with this device's data. Usually not needed; use only if sync has gotten out of sync.
sync.forceUploadConfirm:
Force upload local data to iCloud.
Existing iCloud data will be overwritten. Continue?
sync.forceDownloadInfo: Replaces this device's data with iCloud data. Usually not needed; use only if another device has the latest data.
sync.forceDownloadConfirm:
Force download iCloud data to this device.
Local data will be replaced. Continue?
sync.restoreInfo: Restore from automatic backups (last 3). Backups are created automatically just before sync replaces your data.
sync.restoreNone:
No backups available to restore.
Backups are created automatically just before sync replaces your data.
sync.restoreSelectMessage: Choose a point to restore. Your current data will be replaced with this backup.
sync.restoreConfirmMessage: Replace current data with the backup from {{datetime}}. Continue?
sync.mergeInfo: Pull a single deck from an automatic backup and merge it into your current data. Study progress and history are kept per card (newest wins) and nothing existing is deleted. Useful for recovering when two devices were studied offline and one got overwritten by sync.
sync.mergeSelectBackupMessage: Choose a backup to merge from.
sync.mergeSelectDeckMessage: Choose a deck to merge into your current data. Existing data will not be deleted.
sync.mergeConfirmMessage: Merge "{{name}}" into your current data. Existing data will not be deleted. Continue?
